job.question: Which due diligence questionnaire asks respondents what percentage of their current portfolio companies are located in New Jersey and what percentage are Life Science/Healthcare companies?
job.expected_facts: The NJEDA Appendix A Due Diligence Questionnaire (NJEDA Life Science Seed Fund notice of investment opportunity, 2023), question 4.6 under '4.0 Proposed Fund Investment Strategy'.
job.acceptance: NJEDA Life Science Seed Fund DDQ is sufficient identification; 2023, Appendix A and Q4.6 are optional supporting detail.

reviews.reason: The document identifies an INREV questionnaire for real estate fund of funds and multi-manager mandates, not the NJEDA Life Science Seed Fund questionnaire. It does not ask for percentages of current portfolio companies located in New Jersey or in Life Science/Healthcare; its section 4.6 concerns fees and expenses.
quotes: The Due Diligence Questionnaire for Fund of Funds and Multi-Managers is part of the due diligence protocol which was first launched in April 2007.
Note that in responding to the questionnaire, INREV definitions (www.inrev.org/guidelines) should be used as a point of reference for the terms included.
